Maintenance build.

Blessed Arms now gives a lesser version of every buff for the rest of the run: base strength, constitution and dexterity, both stat pairs, acuity, both armor buffs and haste, at 40% of the cap for your level. A used shrine's buff (60%) takes over its kind for the rest of the act.
Act 5: dormant shrines now stand by camps that con at least yellow to a level 42 character. Shrines by weaker camps move to a stronger one the next time you log in.
Maintenance build.
Maintenance build.
The Warding boon is retired: next to nothing casts on you in an expedition. A run that took it gets a new boon choice in its place (type /run boons).
The resist window now shows your real item resist cap, including increases from Mythirians and the Second Skin boon.

Elite packs remember who you have slain this act. Log out and back in and they return as elites, but repeat kills give lesser spoils: still Rare or better, with half the Unique chance, and normal realm points.
Elite realm points now follow their health: 2.2x a normal monster for an elite, 3.3x for a Stalwart one (was 4x).
Boons now show in your buff bar: one icon per boon, with what it does in its delve info.
The Savage's Savagery buffs (haste, damage, evade, parry and the resist buffs) last 30 seconds instead of 15.
XP turn-in items (Ghoul Hair and the like) no longer drop.
Unique bows now carry archery bonuses (archery damage, speed and range) instead of melee ones; a bow you already have is updated when you log in. Archery speed from items now counts, up to 10%.
Executioner now works on act bosses too: below 10% health, and only to a direct hit.
Vampiric no longer rolls on damage-over-time ticks unless you are a pure caster.
Hall of Fame entries now list the run's boons.
Boons: every boon in an offer now has the same chance; no slot is kept for a loot boon.

Four new boons: Second Skin (+10% to every resist and a higher resist cap), Hunter's Instinct (monsters below half health take 15% more damage), Berserker (+30% melee damage and faster swings, but no healing above 70% health) and Beast Bond (pet classes only: pets have 20% more health and hit 15% harder).
Scavenger and Frostbite are retired, like Greed and Prospector. A run that took one gets a new boon choice in its place (type /run boons).
Unique weapons: Scouts, Hunters and Rangers can now find a unique bow, and the unique exchanger offers the realm's bow.
The Greed and Prospector boons are gone: drops are already frequent enough that they barely showed. A run that took one gets a new boon choice in its place (type /run boons).
The launcher drops the status bar and footer, so the tabs and the Hall of Fame are taller.
Maintenance build.
The launcher is simpler: three tabs, Build History, Character Planner and Options.
The launcher is now DAoC Expedition: a new header with the road through acts I to V and a compass rose, ember and bronze accents, and the new name in the title and windows.
Shared Hall of Fame characters now appear as spectators at the end of the journey. The first: Drunkstains.

SHARE MY WIN now also sends your character's look, so a shared win puts your character among the spectators at the end of your journey; the separate spectator button is gone. If you already shared a win, SHARE MY WIN offers it once more to send the look.
Expedition act bosses never spawn in the air: when the boss's spot is a flying monster's spawn point, it appears on the floor beneath it.
Thrown weapons reach targets above or below you: the first 1,000 units of height no longer count against their range, so the tempters up on Darkness Falls's ledges can be hit with throwing axes.
Darkness Falls shrines next to a camp of flying demons stand on the floor beside it, not up in the walls. Shrines already placed move there, keeping your kills.

Darkness Falls (act 5) shrines stand right beside their camp, just outside its monsters' aggro range and on the same floor, so you can see the shrine from the camp. Shrines already placed move there too, keeping your kills. The messages and the journal give the camp's /loc.
Darkness Falls shrines are chosen from camps all over the dungeon again.
Unique jewelry (necklace, jewel, belt, ring, bracer) wears the artifact jewelry looks, so the uniques you wear stand out on the paper doll. Jewelry you already have changes at your next login.

Darkness Falls (act 5) shrines stand just outside a monster camp on your side of the dungeon, out of its monsters' reach. Each starts dormant (a red crystal): slay a few of that camp's monsters (3 to 6) to wake it, then walk up to it for its blessing. Unused shrines of a run already in act 5 move out of their camps the same way.
Hibernian expeditions can visit the Shrouded Isles again, in the acts their monsters fit: Domnann (acts 1-2), Caillte Garran (2-3), Vigilant Rock (3-4) and Allta Fearann (4).

Every realm: an act's camp now stands among monsters of the act's levels, not the zone's lowest (in many zones it was among gray monsters far from the objectives). Acts already planned keep their camp.

Character Planner: style details in their own columns (fatigue, growth rate, to-hit, defense, effect), and SPECS / REALM ABILITIES buttons so each view gets the full width. The updates tab is first again.

Character Planner tab in the launcher: pick a class, level and realm rank, train spec lines and see the spells, styles and abilities each level unlocks, and buy realm abilities with their real costs and prerequisites. COPY BUILD puts the build on the clipboard.

Darkness Falls (act 5): objectives, the boss and elite packs are now chosen from the camps near your own realm's entrance, so a Midgard run is no longer sent across the dungeon for monsters that only spawn on the Albion side. Runs already in act 5 keep their current objectives.
Elite packs explain their modifier: the expedition status window lists what each one does (and what every elite gets), and the warning when you approach a pack is followed by the same description.
Darkness Falls: naburite drinkers and essence shredders now respawn after 3 minutes (were about 2), like the cambions, soultorns and mahr around them.

Hall of Fame on the launcher's front page: every shared expedition win, with its player, class, play time and seed. Use SHARE MY WIN to add yours (it opens a pre-filled GitHub post; click Submit and it appears for everyone).

Wyrmbane, the Last Ember now procs a real heat bolt (77 damage at level 40, 95 from level 47) instead of a body-damage lifedrain whose description said it healed for 0%. Wyrmbanes you already own update at your next login.
Maintenance build.
The Personal Bind Recall Stone works in Darkness Falls (act 5) and takes you back to the act camp, as in the other acts.
Darkness Falls (act 5) has its Reforger (unique weapon exchange) again: it stands beside the act camp. Before, it could end up in another realm's merchant hall deep in the dungeon.
Maintenance build.
Maintenance build.
Unique weapon glows fixed: they use glows real artifact weapons have (Fenwatch Fang a balefire glow, Wyrmbane a dragonfire glow). Weapons you already own update at your next login.
The boon choice opens as a window when you arrive at a new act's camp (and at login while a choice is still waiting). Before, it was only a chat line; /run boons still shows it any time.
Nereid's Blessing and the faster default swim speed are removed: swimming is back to normal speed. Nereid potions still work.

Valewalker and Vampiir uniques mix melee and caster ToA bonuses (melee damage, spell damage, melee speed, casting speed...) instead of caster ones only. Uniques you already own update at your next login.
Closing the launcher with the X stops a running server first (it is told to save and exit, as Stop does).
Mid-tier uniques (level 20 to 40) have about half the stats, hit points, resists and skills they had; their ToA bonuses stay. Mid-tier uniques you already own update at your next login.

Realm points are fully shared across your account: every time an expedition character logs in, it is topped up to the account's total, so realm points earned on any realm show up on all your characters.
Swimming: everyone gets a permanent Nereid's Blessing buff (it shows in your buff bar) at login and after every death: breathe under water and swim faster.
Water breathing potions (Nereid potions) work again: their effect did nothing on this server before.

Unique ToA bonuses vary from unique to unique instead of every ring, bracer, belt and helm giving melee speed, and higher tiers carry more: early uniques 1 bonus (3%), mid 2 (5% each), late 3 (7% each); weapons one more. Your uniques update at your next login.
Act objectives no longer pick monster camps on a zone's border, where they could sit behind the zone wall (like Myrkwood's wind wisps at 5598, 271).
The launcher opens on a new Build History tab (first, next to Active Population): every fork build and what it changed, newest first, with yours marked (installed).
When an update is waiting, a What's new link next to the version number lists what it brings.
The realm dragons still fly their patrol route, but no longer attack anyone while they do: no glare at the zone and no aggro until they land. Attacking a flying dragon still starts the fight.
Darkness Falls (act 5) has no "reach the far marker" objective any more: compass directions mean little in a dungeon of several floors, so it is another camp to clear instead.
Faster swimming fixed: when the game database has no Nereid potion to copy, everyone swims with the strongest water breathing spell's speed bonus, or +100% if there is none.
Act objectives fit your level when the act begins: camps from one level below you to four above, the named monster two to six above.
Every unique weapon, shield, bow, chest piece and helm now wears a Trials of Atlantis artifact's look (each unique always the same one), on top of the weapon glow.

Uniques carry ToA percentage bonuses: melee classes get melee damage, style damage or melee speed; list casters get spell damage or casting speed. 3% on early uniques, 5% mid, 7% late (the game caps each at 10% from items).

Uniques now level with you: each level up raises every unique you carry to your level (DPS or AF, proc strength) until its cap. Early uniques stop at level 20, mid at 40, late at 50; the item's description says where it stops.
Uniques you already own get the new look and bonuses at your next login (worn items are refreshed automatically).
Unique chest pieces and helms are now Dragonslayer armor, matched to their armor type and your realm.
The two unique cloaks use artifact cloak looks: Mantle of the Grey Lough is Shades of Mist, Shroud of the Pale Tide is Oceanus.
Uniques you already own get their new look at your next login.
/junk epic clears Epic drops (and lower) from your backpack. Uniques are never junked.
New boons: Marked Prey (+20% damage to elites and act bosses), Evasion (10% chance to evade any melee attack), Treasure Sense (Uniques twice as likely) and Swiftfoot (+20% run speed out of combat).
Boons removed: Hunter's Eye, Chain Lightning, Rupture, Unshakable, Second Wind and Warded Hide. A run that had one gets a new boon choice instead.
Style delves (Shift+I) show the style's exact growth rate.
The launcher shows what's new: in the GET UPDATE tooltip, a What's new link, a Build history window, and a one-time note after each update.
Freshly spawned or respawned monsters wait 3 seconds before they can aggro on their own.
Expedition: unique weapons glow, unique chest and helm use the class's epic model; old uniques updated at login.
Expedition: a Supplier at each camp sells the realm's poisons, arrows, bolts and throwing weapons.
Poison vials are not used up when applied.
Expedition: drops require the finder's level so their procs fire; older items fixed at login.
Resting out of combat ramps regeneration up to 10% of the maximum a tick.
Reavers get Weaponry: Flexible from level 1 so the client allows whips.
Reavers can equip flexible weapons from level 1.
Expedition: drops and weapon uniques are re-rolled until usable at the player's current level.
Expedition: /run shrines gives each shrine's direction and distance from you.
Expedition: Gripklosa and Lyonesse act 4 only; an unbegun act in a removed zone is planned again at login.
Expedition: safe camp arrival, no dungeons before act 5, /recover restores deleted characters and their runs.
Players never use up arrows, bolts or throwing weapons.
Expedition: Rare drops have a 97% quality floor.
Expedition: Three Point Oh's Ring is +3 all attributes and +3 all resists; old rings update at login.
Expedition zones: Darkness Falls stays out of other acts' fallback.
Expedition: act 5 is Darkness Falls for every realm, and only act 5.
Expedition: no zone twice in a run; Darkness Falls is the last act.
Expedition: no Shrouded Isles zones in Hibernian runs.
Expedition journal: headed sections, one /loc per line.

Players swim at Greater Nereid potion speed by default.
Expedition: recall stone to camp with no cooldown, Hastener at camp.
Three Point Oh's Ring: +5 to each attribute.
Shrines: announce a discovery on screen.
Docs: store the class boss designs for later.
Expedition: Three Point Oh always drops Three Point Oh's Ring.

Elites: a lone elite is lighter than a pack member.
Expedition: unique weapon exchange (the Reforger).
Expedition: acts in progress pick up new act rules at login.
Expedition: remove the run sky (ExpeditionWeather).
Lesser buffs: icons, spent shrine names, no retry loop for Vampiirs.
Lesser buffs: cast through the potion line so they keep full strength.
Expedition: wild shrines and buff boons.
Expedition: more objectives in later acts, objective XP, named final bosses.
Expedition: experience bonus follows the XP table by player level.
Expedition: experience bonus scales with the act.
Expedition: 2 boon rerolls per run (/run reroll).
Boons: no caster-only boons for pure melee classes.
Expedition: Glory boon, +50% realm points for the rest of the run.
Boons: Vampiric rolls on DoT spell ticks, not on style bleeds.
Boons: Vampiric, Siphon and Chain Lightning ignore damage-over-time ticks.
Expedition: twelve new boons.
Expedition: /loc for the act camp, the boss and elite packs.
Respec anywhere, as often as you like.
Expedition: count kills by damage-over-time ticks.
Expedition: realm points are kept on the account instead of Legacy perks.
Expedition: give runs from before realm points their realm points at login.
Expedition: realm points on runs and an account Legacy that survives death.
Expedition: four new boons - Thornmail, Vampiric, Rejuvenation, Arcane Fury.
Expedition: objective kills count anywhere in the objective's zone.
Expedition: show objective /loc and explain kills in the wrong camp.
Expedition: 5x experience during a run.
Expedition: no stock gear drops during a run, so all equipment has a rarity.
Expedition: no windows, dialogs or weather while the client loads a region.
Launcher: check for a fork update when the server is stopped.
Expedition: promote to the chosen class at once, from level 1.
Expedition loot: bonuses sized to the item's level.
Expedition: automatic class promotion and a gloomy sky on runs.
Expedition: boons, elite packs, fixed uniques, [Common] prefix, /junk.
Expedition loot: Magic and better items always carry bonus lines.
Expedition: scaffolding for boons and elite packs.
Expedition: all three realms, acts built from the world's own monsters.
Expedition loot: grey is con colour only, higher drop rates.
Expedition: /run debug traces every kill and loot roll.
Launcher update check: use the display clock instead of a fourth timer.
Launcher self-update: GET UPDATE replaces START SERVER when a new fork release is out.
Fishing spots: guard the duplicate-name warning so Merge works without logging set up.
Fork release workflow: explicit test filter, report failed tests as annotations.
Player-facing fork releases: installer scripts, release workflow, README for players.
README: step-by-step install, build and deploy guide for this fork, plus how to play Expedition mode and fishing.
Expedition loot: tiered drops on every kill, uniques, richer boss drops.
Expedition mode, phases 1-2: seeded roguelite runs, acts, objectives, act bosses.
Fishing: sit, bobber and effects, fishing spots, no aggro with the pole.
Fishing: prefix template ids with offline_ so stock items can't shadow them.
Add fishing: /fish to relax and fish at any shoreline.
New client: target buttons, server target changes, abilities on the quickbar.
